chrome.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
chrome.footer: You received this email because of an action on MissionHub.

signup.subject: Confirm your email for MissionHub
signup.preheader: One step left to activate your account.
signup.heading: Confirm your email
signup.body: One step left before you can use MissionHub. Confirm that {email} is your email address.
signup.note: The link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't create an account, ignore this email.

recovery.subject: Reset your MissionHub password
recovery.preheader: Use the link to choose a new password.
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.body: We received a request to reset the password for {email}. Click the button to choose a new one.
recovery.note: The link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email; your password stays the same.

magiclink.subject: Your MissionHub sign-in link
magiclink.heading: Sign in to MissionHub
magiclink.body: Use the button below to sign in as {email}.
magiclink.note: The link expires in 1 hour and works once. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email.

invite.subject: You've been invited to MissionHub
invite.preheader: Accept the invitation and create your account.
invite.heading: You've been invited
invite.body: You've been invited to create a MissionHub account with {email}.
invite.note: If you weren't expecting this invitation, ignore this email.

emailChangeCurrent.subject: Confirm the email change on your account
emailChangeCurrent.preheader: Confirm that you asked for this change.
emailChangeCurrent.heading: Confirm your email change
emailChangeCurrent.body: We received a request to change your account email from {email} to {newEmail}. Confirm to continue.
emailChangeCurrent.note: If this wasn't you, ignore this email and change your password.

emailChangeNew.subject: Confirm your new MissionHub email
emailChangeNew.preheader: Confirm the new address for your account.
emailChangeNew.heading: Confirm your new email
emailChangeNew.body: Confirm that {newEmail} is the new email for your MissionHub account.
emailChangeNew.note: The link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this change, ignore this email.

reauthentication.subject: {code} is your verification code
reauthentication.preheader: Use this code to confirm the action.
reauthentication.heading: Your verification code
reauthentication.body: Use the code below to confirm the action on your account.
reauthentication.note: The code expires in 1 hour. Never share it with anyone.

passwordChanged.subject: Your MissionHub password was changed
passwordChanged.preheader: If this wasn't you, reset it now.
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for {email} was just changed.
passwordChanged.note: If it was you, there's nothing to do.

emailChanged.subject: Your MissionHub email was changed
emailChanged.preheader: If this wasn't you, let us know.
emailChanged.heading: Your email was changed
emailChanged.body: Your account email was changed from {oldEmail} to {email}.
emailChanged.note: If you didn't make this change, reset your password and reply to this email.

securityNotice.subject: Security change on your MissionHub account
securityNotice.heading: Your account changed
securityNotice.body: We recorded a security change on {email} ({event}).
securityNotice.note: If this wasn't you, reset your password right away.

teamInvite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {org} on MissionHub
teamInvite.heading: Join {org} on MissionHub
teamInvite.body: {inviter} invited you to join {org}. Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept.
teamInvite.note: This invitation expires in 7 days. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.

candidateRequest.subject: {recruiter} would like to put you forward for {job}
candidateRequest.preheader: Nothing is shared without your confirmation.
candidateRequest.heading: Confirm your referral for {job}
candidateRequest.body: {recruiter} ({org}) would like to present your profile to {partner} for this role. Nothing is shared without your confirmation.
candidateRequest.body2: The link shows exactly what will be sent; you can update your profile, then confirm or decline.
candidateRequest.note: This link is personal, don't forward it. If you don't recognize this request, ignore this email.
